findings.clause: erp-core 1.6.0 checklist C11: "Every error is LocalizedException(Status, <Module>ErrorCodes.X, args); every code has an EN and an AR message"
findings.problem: Error Catalog §5 gives no messageAr/messageEn for INV-404-{WAREHOUSE|BRANCH|VARIANT|ITEM|STOCK-MOVE|TRANSFER|STOCK-COUNT|STOCK-COUNT-LINE|STOCK-ADJUSTMENT|LOT}-NOT-FOUND, INV-404-LOOKUP-KEY-UNKNOWN or INV-422-LOAD-ROWS-INVALID. ADR-INV-021 defers these texts to the erp-core catalogue, but these module-specific codes do not exist there. As planned, InvErrorCodes / messages_ar / messages_en would hold codes with no text. TC-INV-276 and TC-INV-148/257/275 assert the code and status only.
findings.fix: Add an ar and en text to each of these rows in §5. For example: «المستودع غير موجود.» / "The warehouse was not found." (one per resource); «مفتاح القائمة غير معروف.» / "Unknown lookup key."; «بعض أسطر التحميل غير صالحة؛ راجع الأسطر المذكورة.» / "Some rows of the load are invalid; see the listed rows.". Amend ADR-INV-021 to say INV owns these texts; only INV-400/401/500/409-STALE-VERSION reuse the platform texts. Make TC-INV-276 and the LOAD-ROWS-INVALID cases assert the texts.

findings.clause: complete (P2 closure: what happens when something a record depends on changes)
findings.problem: Switching lot tracking on (RULE-INV-044) is allowed while the Item holds stock without a lot (D-18 says such stock exists). After that, RULE-INV-037 refuses every transfer, count and decrease-adjustment line without a lot. The lot-less balance can then never be counted, transferred or written off; only FEFO sales drain it. The Owner has no next step (KB §6.5). No REQ, AC or TC covers this.
findings.fix: Add an unwanted-behaviour REQ and a RULE-INV-037 exception. For a lot-tracked Item, a line that names no lot is accepted up to the quantity held without a lot, and posts against the lot-less balance row (engine step 1 already locks that row first). Beyond that quantity it answers INV-422-LOT-REQUIRED. Add an AC and a backend TC: switch tracking on for an Item holding 5 lot-less units, then count, transfer and write them off. Record the choice in an ADR.

findings.clause: complete (P1 invert REQ-INV-069 / POL-INV-020 / CON-INV-015 'an offline sale is always recorded')
findings.problem: REQ-INV-069 and RULE-INV-019 exempt a synchronised offline sale only from the negative-stock check. The same ISSUE is still refused by RULE-INV-007 (an empty warehouse deactivated after the sale), RULE-INV-018 (Variant or Item deactivated in CAT after the sale) and RULE-INV-008 (a second warehouse added and the sale names none). The goods have already left, so the sale is lost. CON-INV-015 promises otherwise, and no TC covers it.
findings.fix: Extend REQ-INV-069 and the triggers of RULE-INV-007/008/018: for offlineFl true, skip the active-state checks on warehouse, Variant and Item, and apply the default warehouse when none is named. Record the move and notify the Warehouse role, naming the inactive record. Add an AC and an SVC-API-INT TC: an offline sale of a Variant deactivated after the sale is recorded. Record the choice in an ADR, extending ADR-INV-045.

findings.clause: concurrency spot-check (a named guard, not 'validated first')
findings.problem: API-INV-047 creates and posts opening stock in one call. Its Concurrency line accepts that a resubmitted load creates a second adjustment, and relies on the screen disabling the button. A client retry after a timeout, or a double submit, doubles stock and valuation. Moves are immutable (RULE-INV-023), so the only correction is a manual counter-adjustment.
findings.fix: Require an idempotencyKey on OpeningStockRequest. Guard it with the same advisory-lock-then-lookup and request hash as ADR-INV-044 / ADR-INV-048: the same hash returns the first 201, a different hash answers INV-409-IDEMPOTENCY-KEY-REUSED. Add that code as an HTTP row for API-INV-047 in §5 and in api-spec-inv.yaml. Have the frontend generate the key once per load. Add a backend TC: a double submit posts once.

findings.problem: RULE-INV-007 includes ENT-INV-006 in its scope, but an inactive transfer warehouse is refused with RULE-INV-016's code (engine step 0, Error Catalog). Two rules claim one refusal.
findings.fix: Remove ENT-INV-006 from RULE-INV-007's scope, and state in RULE-INV-016 that it owns the inactive-warehouse refusal for transfers.
